title: Gitmal: a static site generator for your Git repositories  #github

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Imagine browsing a Git repo without GitHub, without a server, and without any backend. That's GitL, a static site generator for your Git repositories. Gitmal takes your entire repo, files, folders, commits, diffs, markdown, and turns it into a clean, blazing fast static website. No database, no server, nothing dynamic, just pure HTML you can host anywhere. GitHub pages, Netlefi, S3, you name
